en: because it has not, because it lacks
because it has not, because it lacks
notes: There is no fixed text: singers fit new verses to the chorus, and its last line changes with them. The first chorus is the older one; the second is the best known of the Mexican Revolution.
Satirical verses of the revolution aimed it at Victoriano Huerta and at Venustiano Carranza's troops; they vary from singer to singer and are not printed here.
